_note: Every half-life, decay mode, branching ratio and emission energy here is an evaluated measurement fetched from ENSDF via IAEA-NDS. Nothing in this file is estimated or reconstructed. The ENSDF publication date and author string are carried per isotope so any value can be checked against the evaluated file.
_notInThisFile: Activity (Bq) is NOT here: it depends on how many atoms are present, which is a reactor-physics question, not a nuclear-data question. That is REKORD layer 2 (inventory). The release fraction that turns an inventory into a source term is layer 3 and is genuinely contested; it must be sourced as a range.
